title: 第一卷 第24章 魏兴玩不起
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
第二日晚上，津门码头前的空地被照得跟白天似的透亮。

    津门有头有脸的人物来了不少。

    漕运商会的魏兴坐在最前排，手里端着红酒杯，脸上挂着那种“稳赢”的笑。

    他旁边站着个洋人。

    两米高，壮得像头直立行走的棕熊。

    金发碧眼，满脸横肉，脖子上挂着根手指粗的金链子。

    这就是“绞肉机”汤姆逊。

    全美重量级拳击冠军，据说在擂台上打死过三个黑人拳手。

    汤姆逊正在做热身。

    他对着空气挥拳，拳风呼呼作响，那胳膊比王大刚的大腿还粗。

    “魏，你的对手呢？”

    汤姆逊操着一口生硬的中文，眼神轻蔑，“那个叫陆的，是吓尿裤子不敢来了吗？”

    魏兴赔笑道：“汤姆逊先生稍安勿躁，他肯定来，他不敢不来。”

    “哼，懦夫。”

    汤姆逊不屑地吐了口唾沫。

    就在这时，人群自动分开一条道。

    “让让，让让。”

    赵海柱大摇大摆地走在前面，身后跟着陆川。

    陆川没带那根精铁棍。

    他穿了一身干净的青布练功服，袖口扎紧，脚踩千层底布鞋。

    看着像个去公园遛弯的大爷，跟旁边那个像坦克的洋人比起来，显得太单薄了。

    “哟，来了。”

    魏兴放下酒杯，阴阳怪气道，“陆川，我还以为你缩头了呢。”

    “怎么，没带棍子？”

    “也是，棍子在这种级别的拳王面前，跟牙签没区别。”

    陆川没理他。

    他走到擂台边，抬头看了看。

    擂台是用木板搭的，四周没围绳，就画了个白圈。

    生死擂台。

    “魏胖子，废话少说。”

    陆川指了指汤姆逊，“让他下来受死。”

    汤姆逊听懂了“死”字，怪叫一声，从擂台上一跃而下。

    “轰！”

    木板擂台被踩得一声闷响。

    他走到陆川面前，巨大的阴影把陆川完全笼罩。

    “黄皮猴子，我会把你的脑袋像西瓜一样打爆。”

    汤姆逊挥舞着那两个像火腿一样的拳头，唾沫星子喷了陆川一脸。

    陆川面无表情，伸手擦了擦脸。

    “废话真多。”

    “上去。”

    两人一前一后上了擂台。

    魏兴站起来，大声宣布规则：“二位，咱们有言在先。”

    “擂台无眼，生死有命。”

    “不管谁死在台上，官府和巡捕房绝不追究！”

    “开始！”

    话音刚落，汤姆逊就动了。

    快！

    别看这货块头大，速度快得惊人。

    他脚下踩着滑步，瞬间欺近陆川身前。

    左刺拳虚晃，右重拳如炮弹般轰向陆川的面门。

    这一拳要是打实了，脑袋绝对开花。

    台下传来一片惊呼。

    赵海柱的手都按在了腰间的枪套上。

    陆川没动。

    直到拳风刮得脸皮生疼，他才微微侧头。

    “呼！”

    拳头擦着耳边掠过。

    汤姆逊一击不中，变招极快，左勾拳紧接着扫向陆川的肋部。

    陆川后退半步，又是毫厘之差躲过。

    “跑？我看你能跑到什么时候！”

    汤姆逊狂笑，双拳如暴雨般倾泻而下。

    上勾拳、摆拳、直拳......

    全是杀招。

    陆川在方寸之间辗转腾挪，身法如鬼魅。

    看着惊险，实则游刃有余。

    他在观察。

    这洋人的拳确实重，力气大得吓人。

    但破绽也大。

    太依赖蛮力，下盘虽然稳，但转身慢。

    而且，这人太狂。

    狂的连防守都不要了。

    “打够了吗？”

    陆川突然开口。

    汤姆逊一愣，攻势稍缓。

    就在这一瞬间。

    陆川动了。

    他不退反进，一步踏入汤姆逊的中门。
content_en:
On the second night, the open space in front of Jinmen Pier was illuminated as brightly as during the day.

    There are many famous people in Jinmen.

    Wei Xing from the Water Transport Chamber of Commerce was sitting in the front row, holding a red wine glass in his hand and a "sure-win" smile on his face.

    Next to him stood a foreigner.

    Two meters tall, as strong as a brown bear walking upright.

    Blond and blue-eyed, with a sinewy face and a gold chain as thick as a finger hanging around his neck.

    This is "Meat Grinder" Thomson.

    The American heavyweight boxing champion is said to have killed three black boxers in the ring.

    Thomson is warming up.

    He punched the air, the wind whistling, and the arm was thicker than Wang Dagang's thigh.

    "Wei, where is your opponent?"

    Thomson spoke stilted Chinese with contemptuous eyes, "Is that guy named Lu scared to wet his pants and dare not come?"

    Wei Xing smiled apologetically and said, "Mr. Thomson, please be patient. He will definitely come. He dare not not come."

    "Hmph, coward."

    Thomson spat disdainfully.

    At this moment, the crowd automatically separated into a lane.

    "Give me, let me."

    Zhao Haizhu walked swaggering in front, followed by Lu Chuan.

    Lu Chuan didn't bring the fine iron rod.

    He wore a clean blue cloth training suit, with tightly tied cuffs, and cloth shoes with thousand-layer soles.

    He looks like an old man going for a walk in the park. Compared with the foreigner who looks like a tank next to him, he looks too thin.

    "Yo, here we come."

    Wei Xing put down his wine glass and said in a strange tone, "Lu Chuan, I thought you were shrinking."

    "What, you didn't bring a stick?"

    "Yes, a stick is no different from a toothpick in front of a boxing champion of this level."

    Lu Chuan ignored him.

    He walked to the edge of the ring and looked up.

    The ring was made of wooden boards, and there was no rope around it, so a white circle was drawn around it.

    The arena of life and death.

    "Fat Wei, stop talking nonsense."

    Lu Chuan pointed at Thomson, "Let him come down and die."

    Thomson understood the word "death", screamed strangely, and jumped down from the ring.

    "Boom!"

    The wooden platform was stepped on with a muffled sound.

    He walked up to Lu Chuan, and a huge shadow completely enveloped Lu Chuan.

    "Yellow-skinned monkey, I'll blow your head open like a watermelon."

    Thomson waved his two ham-like fists and sprayed Lu Chuan's face with saliva.

    Lu Chuan had no expression on his face and wiped his face with his hand.

    "So much nonsense."

    "Go up."

    The two entered the ring one after another.

    Wei Xing stood up and announced the rules loudly: "You two, we have something to say first."

    "There are no eyes in the arena, life and death are determined by fate."

    "No matter who dies on the stage, the government and patrol office will never pursue him!"

    "Start!"

    As soon as he finished speaking, Thomson moved.

    quick!

    Despite its size, this guy is incredibly fast.

    He stepped on sliding steps and instantly approached Lu Chuan.

    The left jab feinted, and the right punch hit Lu Chuan's face like a cannonball.

    If this punch is real, his head will definitely blossom.

    There was an exclamation from the audience.

    Zhao Haizhu's hands were pressed on the holster on his waist.

    Lu Chuan didn't move.

    It wasn't until the wind of the fist hurt his face that he turned his head slightly.

    "Phew!"

    The fist grazed the ear.

    Thomson missed the target, changed his moves very quickly, and then swept his left hook towards Lu Chuan's ribs.

    Lu Chuan took half a step back and dodged again by a hair's breadth.

    "Run? Let's see how long you can run!"

    Thomson laughed wildly, and his fists rained down like a rainstorm.

    Uppercut, swing, straight punch...

    All are killing moves.

    Lu Chuan tossed and turned around, his movements like a ghost.

    It looks thrilling, but actually it's quite easy.

    He is observing.

    This foreigner's punches are indeed heavy and his strength is frightening.

    But there are also big flaws.

    Relying too much on brute force, although the foot plate is stable, the turn is slow.

    Moreover, this man is too crazy.

    He's so crazy that he doesn't even want to defend.

    "Have you beaten enough?"

    Lu Chuan suddenly spoke.

    Thomson was stunned and slowed down his attack.

    Just at this moment.

    Lu Chuan moved.

    Instead of retreating, he advanced and stepped into Thomson's mid-range goal.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 24 Wei Xing can’t afford it
